kpis.description_fr: Revenu segment Construction (autoroutes, ponts, lignes ferroviaires, aéroports, ports). 89% du CA total. Bénéficiaire IIJA + IRA US.
kpis.description_en: Construction segment revenue (highways, bridges, rail lines, airports, ports). 89% of total revenue. IIJA + IRA US beneficiary.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu segment Materials (agrégats, asphalte, liquid asphalt, recycled materials). Intégration verticale + ventes tiers.
kpis.description_en: Materials segment revenue (aggregates, asphalt, liquid asphalt, recycled materials). Vertical integration + third-party sales.

kpis.description_fr: Committed and Awarded Projects (CAP) = backlog Granite. Visibilité revenu 18-24 mois. KPI maître secteur infrastructure & construction.
kpis.description_en: Committed and Awarded Projects (CAP) = Granite's backlog. 18-24 month revenue visibility. Master KPI for infrastructure & construction.

kpis.description_fr: Réserves agrégats prouvées + probables. Asset stratégique long-terme (moat secteur).
kpis.description_en: Aggregates proved + probable reserves. Long-term strategic asset (sector moat).

_notes: Granite Construction = #5 contractor US infrastructure routes/ponts. KPIs spécifiques au cycle IIJA-IRA + CAP (backlog) + intégration verticale agrégats. FY23 dans 10-K.

kpis_story.description_fr: Carnet de commandes infrastructure tiré par l'Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act (IIJA) : visibilité revenu pluri-annuelle.
kpis_story.description_en: Infrastructure backlog driven by the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act (IIJA): multi-year revenue visibility.
